_comment: Fixed benchmark set for tools/factory/bench.py -- generated once (seed 20260820) from needs_human/stalled functions that (a) already have a real #ifndef NONMATCHING guard block to splice into, (b) have no #error-placeholder sibling in the same translation unit (agbcc compiles the WHOLE file, so an undrafted sibling fails EVERY candidate for reasons unrelated to draft quality -- see tier3.blocking_siblings()), (c) aren't in a structural-twin group (twins.py already solves those mechanically, not a fair test of raw model skill), and (d) aren't a known libgcc/libc routine (CLAUDE.md Phase 3 -- reproducing compiler-runtime C is a different task than game-logic decompilation). Stratified into three size buckets, 6 each. MUST stay fixed across every variant run in the 5-way comparison, or the runs aren't comparable.
